page.title: Projects
page.empty_hint: Choose a repository and an execution squad to get your first issue moving.

detail.description_hint: Shared with agents as context for every task in this project.
detail.empty_issues_hint: Create a new issue or assign existing ones to this project.
detail.first_issue_hint: Describe what needs to be done. Choose a squad or another assignee when creating the issue.
detail.link_existing_title: Link an issue to this project
detail.link_existing_hint: Choose an issue that does not belong to a project yet.
detail.link_failed: Could not link the issue. Try again.
detail.empty_view_hint: Choose another view or adjust the filters to find project issues.

resources.local_daemon_offline_hint: Start the local daemon to attach a directory on this machine.
resources.local_daemon_already_attached_hint: This machine already has a local directory attached. Remove it before adding another.
resources.local_no_daemon_tooltip: Local daemon isn't reporting an ID yet — the agent can't open this directory.
resources.local_other_machine_tooltip: Only available on the machine that registered this directory.
resources.chat_hint_worktree_prefix: Agent will work in an isolated worktree of
resources.chat_hint_worktree_note: Your working copy stays untouched — each task hands its work back as an agent/… branch.
resources.toast_local_already_attached: This directory is already attached to the project on this machine.
resources.toast_local_daemon_already_attached: This machine already has a local directory attached to this project. Remove it before adding another.
resources.local_validate_unsupported: Local directories can only be picked on the desktop app.
resources.mode_dialog_title: How should tasks use this folder?
resources.mode_dialog_description: This decides how you get an agent's work back, and whether tasks on this folder can run at the same time.
resources.mode_in_place_description: One task at a time. Changes appear in your working copy as the agent makes them, ready for you to keep working on.
resources.mode_worktree_description: Tasks run at the same time without touching your working copy. Each one hands back an agent/… branch in this repo for you to review and merge.
resources.mode_worktree_needs_git: This folder is not a git repository, so there is nowhere to put the branch. Pick a repository, or keep editing the folder directly.
resources.mode_worktree_needs_server_upgrade: Your Multica server is too old to run tasks in parallel — it would quietly run them in this folder instead. Update the server, then switch this on.
resources.mode_edit_tooltip: Change how tasks use this folder
resources.mode_badge_worktree_tooltip: Tasks run at the same time in their own git worktree and hand back a branch. Your working copy is untouched.
resources.toast_local_mode_update_failed: Could not update the execution mode

delete_dialog.title: Delete project
delete_dialog.description: This will delete the project. Issues will not be deleted but will be unlinked.

execution_squad.label: Execution squad
execution_squad.unavailable_hint: This squad or template is unavailable to you. Choose another.
execution_squad.catalog_failed: Could not load squad templates. Try again when the connection is restored.
execution_squad.existing_runtime_hint: Uses the squad’s current runtime. Its availability will be checked on the project.
execution_squad.prepare_hint: Creates the missing roles and skills and keeps existing customizations. No project issue starts until you submit it.
execution_squad.choose_runtime_hint: Choose a runtime now, or connect one later. Your squad choice will be saved.
execution_squad.local_runtime_hint: Only runtimes on a machine with a project directory are available.
execution_squad.wrong_machine_hint: The squad’s actual execution machine cannot access this project’s local directory. Choose a matching squad or review its runtimes.
execution_squad.none_hint: Choose a squad to handle this project’s next issue.
execution_squad.needs_runtime_hint: Your project and squad choice are saved. Connect a runtime, then finish setup.
execution_squad.offline_hint: Connect the squad’s execution machine before handing it an issue.
execution_squad.ready_hint: Describe the next issue. Review the trigger preview before creating it.
execution_squad.future_only: This changes defaults for future issues. Existing issues keep their assignees.
execution_squad.save_failed: Could not save the squad choice. Try again.

errors.agent_name_conflict: A role name is already in use. Rename the conflicting agent or choose an existing squad.
errors.agent_access_denied: You do not have access to a required agent. Choose a squad you can use.
errors.agent_unavailable: A required agent is unavailable. Restore it or choose another squad.
errors.runtime_unavailable: The selected runtime is unavailable. Connect it or choose another.
errors.runtime_mismatch: Existing squad members use another runtime. Review the squad’s runtimes or choose another squad.
errors.squad_unavailable: This squad is missing, archived, or unavailable to you. Choose another.
errors.preparation_failed: Your project is saved. Squad setup could not finish. Retry setup or choose another squad.

execution_squad.runtime_load_failed: Could not load runtimes. Your selection is kept; try again when the connection is restored.
execution_squad.purpose: AI agents that plan, carry out, and review work together.
execution_squad.selection_hint: The first squad is the default. You can choose a different squad for each task.
execution_squad.skip_hint: You can add squads later in the project.
execution_squad.prepare_simple: Squads are prepared on creation; work starts when you submit a task.
execution_squad.runtime_optional: Choose where the AI runs, or connect it later. Your squad choices will be saved.
execution_squad.manage_description: Choose which squads can handle project issues. Each issue has one assignee; the default is preselected for new issues.
execution_squad.default_unavailable: The default squad is unavailable. Review its setup or choose another squad.
execution_squad.remove_description: Only the project association is removed. Existing issues keep their assignees.

management.unsupported: This server does not support project management yet. Existing project actions remain available.
management.load_error: Could not load project management. Retry to get the latest information.
management.permission_lost: You no longer have access to this project.
management.utc_default: Planning timezone is not configured; UTC is used.
management.timezone_hint: IANA timezone, for example Asia/Shanghai. Leave empty to use UTC.
management.lead_invalid: The project lead is unavailable. Choose a current member or agent in Properties.
management.environment: Some assigned execution environments are unavailable. Review the project resources and squads.
management.project_overdue: The project is past its due date.
management.date_invalid: Start date is after due date. Correct the project dates.
management.migration_since: Historical start time is unknown; progress age is measured from the upgrade.
management.risk_scope: All matching formal issues, including sub-issues. Personal and saved-view filters do not apply.
management.refreshed: The project changed. Counts and results have been refreshed together.
management.stale_acceptance: For an older description; review again
management.body_hint: What changed, what is next, and what needs attention?
management.evidence_hint: One HTTP/HTTPS URL, issue UUID, or execution UUID per line.
management.not_published: Publication has not been confirmed. Your input has been kept.
management.agent_reference: Agent mentions are references and do not start execution.
management.preview_stale: The preview changed. Review the new facts before publishing again.
management.conflict: The server has a newer version. Compare before saving.
management.description_unsupported: This server does not support safe description editing. Update the server to edit; your text is preserved.
management.template_empty: All selected headings already exist. Select missing sections.
management.template_intro: Selected sections are appended to the description. Existing content is preserved.
management.complete_hint: {{open}} open issues · {{cancelled}} cancelled. Project completion does not change issues or execution.
management.delete_impact: {{issues}} linked issues are preserved. {{updates}} progress updates and {{resources}} project resources are removed; {{automations}} automations are disabled.

reasons.unassigned_issues: Some issues need a valid assignee.
reasons.stale_progress: No progress has been published for seven planning days.
reasons.ended_project_open_issues: This ended project still has open issues.
reasons.execution_environment_unavailable: An assigned execution environment is unavailable.
reasons.unknown_status: Some issue statuses cannot be classified.

management.refresh_failed: Refresh failed. These are the last available statistics.
management.deleted_copy_hint: You can copy your unsent text. This project can no longer be edited.
management.property_retry_hint: Your attempted changes are below. Retry uses the latest project version; review date or validation errors before retrying.
management.source_forbidden: An evidence source is no longer accessible. Your text is kept; remove that evidence before previewing again.
management.continuation_changed: Data changed while you continued after the previous position. Refresh from the start to include new or re-entered matches before it.
management.empty_risk_suffix: No matches after this position. Earlier matches may still exist; refresh from the start to see them.

iterations.title: Iterations
iterations.unsupported: Iterations are unavailable on this server.
iterations.error: The request failed. Your input has been kept. Refresh the preview before trying again.
iterations.disabled: Iterations are disabled. An owner or administrator can enable manual planning.
iterations.name: Name
iterations.retain: Retain completed or cancelled tasks in the starting scope
iterations.unknownResult: The outcome is unknown. Check the original request or retry it with the same identity.
iterations.readonly: This history is frozen at closure.
iterations.permission: Access was denied. Your input has been kept.
iterations.overdue: Past planned end date — this iteration remains active.
iterations.countHint: Counts represent tasks, not workload. Parent tasks and subtasks each count once.
iterations.conflict: The iteration changed. Your choices are kept. Refresh the preview to review the current state.
iterations.tooLarge: This operation exceeds the server limit. No changes were applied.
iterations.nameTooLong: The iteration name must be 200 characters or fewer.
iterations.validationReason: Enter a reason before previewing this change.
iterations.validationTerminal: Review whether each completed or cancelled task should remain in the starting scope.
iterations.validationActive: Another iteration is active. End it first, or use the explicit handoff action.
iterations.validationMoves: The remaining task set changed. Refresh the preview and review every destination.
iterations.validationTarget: This destination cannot accept the task. Choose an available planned iteration or remove it from the iteration.
iterations.validationTriage: This task needs triage before it can join an iteration.
iterations.validationMissing: A selected task is no longer available. Refresh and review your selection.
iterations.validationRollover: This task has reached the supported rollover limit. Remove it from the iteration instead.
iterations.validationDelete: Only an unused empty plan can be deleted. Cancel this iteration to preserve its history.
iterations.validationDates: The planned dates do not allow starting now. Adjust the dates or choose Start today for a future plan.
iterations.validationUnknown: This change cannot be confirmed. Refresh the preview and review the selected tasks and destinations.
iterations.rolloverReview: Rolled over at least three times. Review scope, split the task, or remove it from the plan.
iterations.manualModeDescription: Manual planning: iterations never start or end automatically. Planning actions never start or stop task executions.
iterations.overlapWarning: These dates overlap another open iteration. Only one iteration can be active at a time.
iterations.overallScope: Summary metrics always describe the whole iteration. Filters affect only this task list.
iterations.deletedOrUnavailable: Task deleted or no longer accessible. Historical values are preserved.
iterations.executionUnchanged: Ending or cancelling an iteration does not stop running executions or change task status.
iterations.currentNames: Linked names reflect the current directory; frozen task facts remain unchanged.
iterations.unknownMode: This planning mode is not supported. History remains readable.
